metadata.description: Friendly Japanese cognitive-aid skills for office life — explain, verify, decompose, summarize, gap-find, decide.

plugins.name: ja-office-skills
plugins.description: All 11 friendly-Japanese office-life skills (kantan, honto, bunkai, youten, nukemore, yougo, maemuki, utagai, kotae-awase + ja/en translators)

plugins.name: kantan
plugins.description: Explain technical terms to non-engineers in friendly Japanese

plugins.name: honto
plugins.description: Verify an AI answer: confidence, weak spots, how to check, alternative views

plugins.name: bunkai
plugins.description: Decompose a complex topic or process into parts/steps, jargon-free Japanese

plugins.name: youten
plugins.description: Compress a document (PDF/image/long text/URL) into 3 key points

plugins.name: nukemore
plugins.description: Surface gaps, assumptions, and questions in a ticket/PR/spec before starting work

plugins.name: yougo
plugins.description: Explain Japanese business terms (稟議・検収・工数…) with context and example sentences

plugins.name: maemuki
plugins.description: Surface hidden costs and assumptions before saying yes to a request

plugins.name: utagai
plugins.description: Question your own thinking — find holes in a plan or diagnosis

plugins.name: kotae-awase
plugins.description: Check your interpretation of a Japanese message: match score, nuance, reply direction

plugins.name: ja
plugins.description: Translate the previous message or argument to Japanese

plugins.name: en
plugins.description: Translate the previous message or argument to English
